title: Big Strong Samson
textBlocks:
Hello Bravehearts
In today’s true Bible story, 
you will hear about a 
very strong man that God made

This is how the story starts, the Angel of the Lord appeared to a woman who could not have babies.
She was married to a man named MANOAH.

The Angel of the Lord told Manoah’s wife that she would have a boy child.
But she was never to drink wine or beer or eat anything unclean.
AND THEY WEREN’T ALLOWED TO CUT THE CHILD’S HAIR
Manoah also wanted to speak to the Angel, so he prayed to the Lord, and the Angel came back.

Manoah wanted to prepare a meal for the Angel, a young goat.
But the Angel said that he won’t eat the meal - that it should be an offering.

WHEN MANOAH PUT THE GOAT ON THE ROCK
AN AMAZING THING HAPPENED…
A FLAME WENT UP FROM THE ROCK THE ANGEL WENT UP IN THE FLAME

She did just as the Angel said, she never drank wine or beer. 
She gave birth to a boy and named him
SAMSON
